summary: Spend ledger (#1352): record spend_interval rows under .agentic/ledger with optional token, routing, handoff, and outcome fields; attribute spend per run/cloud agent and report unattributed intervals separately; compute all-in run cost from recorded fields only.
migration_impact: Additive ledger record_type spend_interval and plate_ledger_record_spend MCP tool. plate_costs / gh plate costs gain spend_report and run_cost modes. Existing decision ledger JSON loads unchanged.
migration_guidance: 1. Callers record intervals via plate_ledger_record_spend or gh plate ledger --record-spend (pass only measured fields).
2. Pilot attribution: gh plate costs --spend-report or plate_costs spend_report=true.
3. One run all-in: gh plate costs --run-cost --run-id <id> or plate_costs run_cost=true.
agent_notes: Never invent token or cost values. cost_per_accepted_outcome_usd uses intervals where outcome_accepted=true and cost_usd was recorded.
